paper_outline:
  - section: abstract
    word_budget: 250
    core_bullets:
      - "Problem: LLM agents exhibit semantic stagnation—executing diverse but collectively unproductive action sequences that evade repetition detectors and overwhelm LLM-based judges"
      - "Approach: systematic empirical study via weak supervision pipeline (3 LFs + MV) on 2 SE agents (SWE-Agent 54K windows, OpenHands 150K windows), comparing structural features, NL embedding probe, and LLM-as-judge"
      - "Finding 1 (primary): stagnation signals are structural—30 features achieve RF 0.995 in-domain, GB 0.967 cross-agent, +24.3pp over LLM-judge, encoder-agnostic (3 encoders all >0.90)"
      - "Finding 2: Label quality is the transfer bottleneck—cmd_rep leads by -1.87 steps on SWE-Agent but lags +3.32 on OH; correcting label version bias shifts OH stag rate 6.56%→21.45%; prevalence-matched ablation shows cmd_rep's value is coverage (-29.4pp when removed)"
      - "Finding 3: three TLM implementations (TWV/HMM/lag-HMM) all fail vs MV; TWV degrades downstream up to -21.7pp in low-conflict 3-LF regime"
      - "[GOLD_SET_PLACEHOLDER: gold set validation results pending 5/17]"
    dependencies: [experiments, method]
    tables: []
    figures: []
    registry_refs: [non-nlp-baseline, cross-agent-structural, baseline-llm-judge, oh-cmdrep-ablation, temporal-label-model]

  - section: introduction
    word_budget: 1100
    core_bullets:
      - "Hook: LLM coding agents fail silently at scale—SlopCodeBench documents 90% verbosity increase and 80% quality erosion in long tasks, yet agents continue reporting confidence. The failure mode is not repetition but semantic stagnation: diverse actions that collectively make no progress"
      - "Gap: existing monitoring detects structural repetition (misses semantic-diverse stagnation), scores individual steps (loses window-level temporal dynamics), or relies on LLM self-evaluation (expensive + limited by the stuck model's own judgment). No systematic study examines WHAT signals actually carry stagnation information"
      - "Insight: stagnation is fundamentally structural—command repetition rates, file diff patterns, and outcome trajectories predict it near-perfectly WITHOUT semantic understanding. This overturns the intuition that detecting subtle agent failures requires sophisticated language understanding"
      - "Contributions: (C1) structural signal discovery—redirects monitoring from representation learning to lightweight features; (C2) LF temporal dynamics—agent-specific roles + circular evaluation methodology; (C3) TLM negative finding—constrains future temporal label model research"
    dependencies: [experiments]
    citation_hints:
      - "SlopCodeBench (arxiv 2603.24755) for motivation"
      - "AgentPRM (arxiv 2511.08325) as PRM competitor"
      - "ICLR 2025 Workshop monitoring paper for sequence-level monitoring"
      - "Snorkel/Ratner for WS background"
      - "SWE-bench, SWE-Agent, OpenHands for data sources"
    figures: [fig_pipeline]
    tables: []
    registry_refs: [non-nlp-baseline, cross-agent-structural, baseline-llm-judge, oh-cmdrep-ablation]

  - section: related_work
    word_budget: 700
    core_bullets:
      - "Process Reward Models: AgentPRM, InversePRM, ToolPRMBench, trajectory-level RM → need outcome labels + RL pipeline, step-level scoring; we are window-level monitoring via WS, no outcome labels needed"
      - "Agent Self-Reflection & Verification: Reflexion, LATS, ToT, agent verification → intervention not monitoring; relies on the stuck agent itself"
      - "Weak Supervision: Snorkel, FlyingSquid, Safranchik linked HMM (NER-specific) → i.i.d. assumption; our TLM negative finding shows temporal extension does not help in low-conflict LF regimes"
      - "Agent Monitoring & Degradation: SlopCodeBench, ICLR 2025 monitoring, weak-to-strong monitoring → motivates the problem; we provide systematic detection study"
      - "Cycle/Anomaly Detection: CDCS+CDSA, SpecRA, TrajAD → structural repetition only, misses semantic-diverse stagnation"
    dependencies: [introduction]
    citation_hints:
      - "PRMs: AgentPRM, PRM framework 2502.10325, ToolPRMBench 2601.12294, trajectory RM 2604.08178"
      - "Self-reflection: Reflexion Shinn 2023, LATS Zhou 2023, ToT Yao 2024"
      - "WS: Snorkel Ratner 2017+2020, FlyingSquid Fu 2020, Safranchik AAAI 2020"
      - "Monitoring: ICLR 2025 Workshop, weak-to-strong 2508.19461"
      - "Degradation: SlopCodeBench 2603.24755"
    figures: []
    tables: []
    registry_refs: []

  - section: method
    word_budget: 1300
    core_bullets:
      - "Problem Formulation: trajectory T = (a_1,...,a_n) → overlapping windows w_i of size k; binary classification y_i ∈ {stagnation, progress}; window-level captures temporal dynamics lost by step-level scoring"
      - "Weak Supervision Pipeline: 3 labeling functions → majority vote → silver labels; confidence = number of agreeing LFs; conf≥2 subset for high-quality evaluation"
      - "LF Design: (1) command_repetition—ratio of repeated commands in window; (2) file_diff_delta—frequency of code changes; (3) outcome_backpropagation—distant supervision from task outcome propagated backward. Each targets a different stagnation signal"
      - "Structural Feature Extraction: 30 dimensions per window—repetition rates (exact/fuzzy), unique command ratio, file operation counts, edit distances, output entropy, action type distribution. No embedding model required"
      - "NL Embedding Probe (ProgressProbe): GRU (hidden=256, layers=2) + attention pooling over Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (1024-dim) window embeddings → binary classification. Baselines: mean-pool + LR, cosine similarity"
      - "LLM-as-Judge Baseline: Claude Sonnet zero-shot window-level classification"
      - "Temporal Label Models: (a) TWV—Gaussian-weighted smoothing of LF activations with bandwidth σ; (b) HMM—hidden Markov model with LF emissions; (c) Lag-aware HMM—incorporates empirical per-LF temporal offsets"
    dependencies: []
    notation_table:
      T: "agent trajectory (a_1, ..., a_n)"
      w_i: "window of k consecutive actions at step i"
      k: "window size (default 5)"
      y_i: "binary label: 0=stagnation, 1=progress"
      lambda_j: "labeling function j ∈ {cmd_rep, file_diff, outcome_bp}"
      sigma: "TWV Gaussian smoothing bandwidth"
      conf: "number of agreeing LFs (1-3)"
    figures: [fig_pipeline]
    tables: [tab_lf_design]
    registry_refs: [emb_001, probe_001]

  - section: experiments
    word_budget: 2000
    core_bullets:
      - "Setup: SWE-Agent (54,809 windows from SWE-bench trajectories, 28.5% stag) + OpenHands (150,652 windows, 20.9% stag); conf≥2 test set (N=1,824); metric = Macro-F1; circular eval caveat stated upfront"
      - "§5.1 Main Results (Tab 1): Structural RF 0.9951 > Probe 0.9055 > Mean-pool 0.8435 > LLM-judge 0.6625 > Cosine-sim 0.5606; structural +8.96pp over best neural, +24.3pp over LLM"
      - "§5.2 Cross-Agent (Tab 1 right cols): Structural GB 0.967 on OH vs Probe 0.528 zero-shot (0.751 with 50% finetune); structural naturally transfers without adaptation"
      - "§5.3 Robustness: Encoder ablation (SFR/bge-m3/e5-large all >0.90); window size (k=5 optimal, ±5.9pp/1.8pp); data scaling (monotonic 0.805→0.906); multi-seed (mean 0.919±0.011)"
      - "§5.4 LF Temporal Dynamics (Tab 2, Fig 2): cmd_rep leading (-1.87 steps), file_diff concurrent (-1.2), OB lagging (+6.7); all pairwise significant (Bonferroni-corrected); OH reversal: cmd_rep → lagging +3.32 steps"
      - "§5.5 cmd_rep Ablation (Tab 3): Removing cmd_rep on OH: finetune F1 0.751→0.927 (+17.6pp); root cause: 92.3% firing rate + 71% FP on OH progress windows"
      - "§5.6 TLM Results (Tab 4): MV 0.895 baseline; TWV σ=2 conf≥2 0.900 (+0.6pp) but downstream degradation -4.9pp in-domain, -21.7pp cross-agent; HMM stag overpredict; lag-HMM 0.894 ≈ MV"
      - "[GOLD_SET_PLACEHOLDER: §5.7 Gold Set Validation—pending 5/17]"
    dependencies: []
    registry_refs:
      - non-nlp-baseline      # structural baselines
      - cross-agent-structural # cross-agent structural
      - probe_001              # NL probe reference
      - probe-multiseed        # multi-seed stability
      - baseline-meanpool-lr   # mean-pool baseline
      - baseline-llm-judge     # LLM-as-judge
      - cosinesim-check        # cosine sim baseline
      - baseline-lf-oracle     # LF oracle
      - encoder-ablation-probe-bgem3   # encoder ablation
      - encoder-ablation-probe-e5large # encoder ablation
      - ablation-window-size   # window size
      - data-scaling-v2        # data scaling
      - lf-temporal-dynamics   # LF temporal
      - oh-cmdrep-ablation     # cmd_rep ablation on OH
      - oh-full-finetune       # OH full finetune
      - cross-agent-eval       # probe cross-agent
      - openhands-fewshot-probe # few-shot transfer
      - temporal-label-model   # TLM implementations
      - twv-ablation           # TWV σ sweep
      - tlm-probe-comparison   # TLM downstream eval
    tables: [tab_main_results, tab_lf_temporal, tab_oh_cmdrep, tab_tlm_comparison, tab_dataset_stats]
    figures: [fig_lf_temporal, fig_data_scaling]

  - section: analysis
    word_budget: 500
    core_bullets:
      - "Circular Evaluation: structural 0.9951 is expected—features ≈ LF rule inputs, labels = LF rule outputs. This is an upper bound on LF reverse-engineering, not a meaningful detection result. Cross-agent OH (0.967) is non-circular. Gold set is the ultimate arbiter"
      - "Why TLM Fails in 3-LF Regime: conf≥2 agreement rate 95.1% → little room for temporal correction; TWV's conf=1 flips are directionally wrong; need >10 LFs with higher conflict for TLM to potentially help"
      - "Error Analysis: 131 errors (7.2%), 64.9% FP—probe flags windows that LFs miss (semantic-diverse stagnation not covered by 3 LFs)"
      - "OB as Privileged Distant Supervision: 3-seed holdout shows removing OB → -22pp F1; 7.1pp is pure signal contribution beyond cmd_rep+file_diff"
    dependencies: [experiments]
    tables: []
    figures: []
    registry_refs: [error-analysis, confidence-gradient, train-without-ob, outcome-bp-3seed]

  - section: conclusion
    word_budget: 350
    core_bullets:
      - "Summary: three findings—structural dominance, agent-specific LF dynamics, TLM negative"
      - "Practical implication: agent monitoring should use lightweight structural features (<5ms, no GPU) over expensive embedding or LLM approaches"
      - "Limitations: (1) 2 SE agents—generalization to non-SE agents untested; (2) circular evaluation on LF-derived labels (gold set pending); (3) 3 LFs too few for TLM to show value; (4) no online/intervention evaluation"
      - "Future: non-SE agent domains, online integration, LF scaling, curriculum training from stagnation signals"
    dependencies: [experiments, analysis]
    tables: []
    figures: []
    registry_refs: []

visualization_plan:
  - fig_id: fig_pipeline
    type: conceptual
    tool: paperbanana
    description: >
      System pipeline overview: (left) raw agent trajectory → sliding window extraction (k=5);
      (center) 3 LFs (cmd_rep, file_diff, outcome_bp) → majority vote → silver labels with confidence;
      (right) three detection approaches compared: structural features (30-dim), NL embedding probe (GRU),
      LLM-as-judge. Arrows show data flow. Color-code the three approaches.
    placement: method
    aspect_ratio: "2:1"
    data_source: "manual"

  - fig_id: fig_lf_temporal
    type: statistical
    tool: matplotlib
    description: >
      LF temporal dynamics on SWE-Agent: violin or box plot showing lag distribution
      (steps relative to stagnation onset) for each LF. X-axis: LF name (cmd_rep, file_diff, outcome_bp).
      Y-axis: lag (negative=leading, positive=lagging). Horizontal line at 0.
      Show median, quartiles. Annotate mean lag values. Optional: small inset or side panel
      showing OH cmd_rep reversal.
    placement: experiments
    aspect_ratio: "4:3"
    data_source: "registry: lf-temporal-dynamics"

  - fig_id: fig_data_scaling
    type: statistical
    tool: matplotlib
    description: >
      Data scaling curve: X-axis = training data percentage (10%, 25%, 50%, 100%),
      Y-axis = Macro-F1. Line plot with markers for NL probe performance.
      Horizontal dashed line for structural RF baseline (0.9951) as reference ceiling.
      Annotate each point with F1 value. Show the monotonic trend clearly.
    placement: experiments
    aspect_ratio: "3:2"
    data_source: "registry: data-scaling-v2, non-nlp-baseline"

table_plan:
  - table_id: tab_main_results
    caption: "Stagnation detection: structural features vs. neural and LLM approaches. Macro-F1 on conf≥2 test sets. SWE = in-domain SWE-Agent; OH = cross-agent OpenHands transfer."
    placement: experiments
    type: comparison
    columns: [Method, "SWE Macro-F1", "SWE F1_stag", "SWE F1_prog", "OH Macro-F1", "OH F1_stag", "OH F1_prog"]
    data_source: "registry: non-nlp-baseline, cross-agent-structural, probe_001, baseline-meanpool-lr, cosinesim-check, baseline-llm-judge, baseline-lf-oracle, cross-agent-eval, oh-full-finetune"
    notes: "Bold best, underline second. Footnote: SWE results are circular (eval on LF-derived labels); OH cross-agent is non-circular. [GOLD_SET] row to be added."

  - table_id: tab_lf_design
    caption: "Labeling function design and per-agent coverage statistics."
    placement: method
    type: statistics
    columns: [LF, "Signal Type", "SWE Fire Rate", "SWE Stag Precision", "OH Fire Rate", "OH Stag Precision"]
    data_source: "registry: cross-agent-eval, emb_001"

  - table_id: tab_lf_temporal
    caption: "Temporal roles of labeling functions relative to stagnation onset (SWE-Agent). All pairwise comparisons significant after Bonferroni correction."
    placement: experiments
    type: statistics
    columns: ["Labeling Function", "Mean Lag (steps)", "% Leading", "% Concurrent", "% Lagging"]
    data_source: "registry: lf-temporal-dynamics"

  - table_id: tab_oh_cmdrep
    caption: "Impact of removing command_repetition LF on OpenHands cross-agent transfer. cmd_rep has 92.3% firing rate and 71% false positive rate on OH progress windows."
    placement: experiments
    type: ablation
    columns: [LF Config, "Zero-Shot F1", "Finetune F1", "Finetune F1_stag", "Finetune F1_prog"]
    data_source: "registry: oh-cmdrep-ablation, cross-agent-eval, oh-full-finetune"
    baseline_row: "3-LF (with cmd_rep)"

  - table_id: tab_tlm_comparison
    caption: "Temporal label model comparison. None improves over majority vote; TWV degrades downstream classifiers."
    placement: experiments
    type: comparison
    columns: [Label Method, "Conf≥2 F1", "MV Agreement", "Downstream SWE F1", "Downstream OH F1"]
    data_source: "registry: temporal-label-model, twv-ablation, tlm-probe-comparison"
    notes: "Downstream = probe trained on method's labels, evaluated against MV conf≥2 ground truth."

  - table_id: tab_dataset_stats
    caption: "Dataset statistics."
    placement: experiments
    type: statistics
    columns: [Agent, Source, Windows, "Stag %", "Conf≥2", "Conf≥2 Stag %"]
    data_source: "registry: emb_001, cross-agent-eval"

  # --- Appendix tables ---
  - table_id: tab_encoder_ablation
    caption: "Encoder ablation: NL probe performance is consistent across three embedding models (all >0.90 Macro-F1)."
    placement: appendix
    type: ablation
    columns: [Encoder, Dim, "Macro-F1", "F1_stag", "F1_prog"]
    data_source: "registry: probe_001, encoder-ablation-probe-bgem3, encoder-ablation-probe-e5large"
    baseline_row: "SFR-Embedding (Qwen3-0.6B)"

  - table_id: tab_window_ablation
    caption: "Window size ablation. k=5 is optimal; k=3 loses context, k=7 introduces noise."
    placement: appendix
    type: ablation
    columns: [k, "Macro-F1", "F1_stag", "F1_prog", "Δ vs k=5"]
    data_source: "registry: ablation-window-size"
    baseline_row: "k=5"

  - table_id: tab_architecture_ablation
    caption: "Probe architecture ablation."
    placement: appendix
    type: ablation
    columns: [Architecture, Params, "Macro-F1", "F1_stag", "F1_prog"]
    data_source: "registry: ablation-architecture"
    baseline_row: "GRU + Attention"

  - table_id: tab_multiseed
    caption: "Multi-seed stability of the NL embedding probe (5 seeds)."
    placement: appendix
    type: statistics
    columns: [Seed, "Macro-F1", "F1_stag", "F1_prog"]
    data_source: "registry: probe-multiseed"
